name: Milankumar Patel
title: Alumni · Masters
bio:
Milan's primary inclination of research during his master thesis was to understand and come up with an approach to explain the Digital trust relationship-building process between IoT devices using a formal/ontological approach. He implemented the Trust relationship theory to create a Java-based Simulator to evaluate IoT device properties and give a reasonable response about a device's trustworthiness based on pre-set conditions. He published a research paper in IEEE journal under Dr. Bhattacharyya's tutelage.

Currently, he is working for Revel Systems as a CloudOps (DevOps) Engineer. Milan is an AWS Certified Cloud Solution Architect.
